title: Morning Deep Breathing
hook: What if you breathe deep every morning?

beats.label: After ten minutes
beats.line: After ten minutes, your breathing slows and oxygen rises.
beats.idea: Close-up of lungs inflating with a pink glow, chest expanding like a balloon.

beats.label: By day one
beats.line: By day one, your resting heart rate drops a few beats.
beats.idea: Heart icon pulses slower beside the character, showing a calm rhythm.

beats.label: After a week
beats.line: After a week, your cortisol levels fall, stress feels lighter.
beats.idea: Gray cortisol cloud above the head fades while a smooth breathing line appears.

beats.label: After a month
beats.line: After a month, your blood pressure drops and arteries relax.
beats.idea: Gauge needle moves down; blood vessels widen and glow softly.

beats.label: Six months in
beats.line: Six months in, lung capacity rises and endurance improves.
beats.idea: Lungs enlarge; character jogs effortlessly while a distance meter rises.

description: A short cartoon shows how daily deep breathing transforms your body over time.
topic: What happens if you practice deep breathing each morning?
